release_notes:
MyZong patches for stock **5.19.19.112**.

- Renamed the embedded bundle to **MyZong**, replacing Zong Home Cleanup in Morphe's bundle information.
- Replaced template/local metadata with the project author and repository links.
- Standardized generated bundle/APK filenames and the Gradle project name.

Build succeeded. Every bundle payload entry is byte-identical to the tested v1.2.22 release; only META-INF/MANIFEST.MF changed. Patch behavior and selections are unchanged.

Refresh the remote source in Morphe and update to **1.2.23** to receive the corrected bundle metadata. If the source itself still has an old custom label, re-add it using [Add MyZong to Morphe](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=FarhanZafarr-9%2Fmyzong-patches&name=MyZong).

Assets: MyZong-1.2.23.mpp and SHA256SUMS.txt. Source archives are available from this tag; no installable APK was rebuilt.
